name: prolog-graph-cli
title: Prolog Graph CLI
blurb: SWI-Prolog CLI: shortest path in a directed weighted graph from an edge list
default_description: Compute shortest paths in weighted directed graphs

verify.name: usage-error
verify.cmd:
set +e
./bin/{{ npm_name }} >/dev/null 2>&1
status=$?
echo "exit status: $status"
test "$status" -eq 2

verify.name: missing-file
verify.cmd:
set +e
./bin/{{ npm_name }} /nonexistent/graph.txt A B >/dev/null 2>&1
status=$?
echo "exit status: $status"
test "$status" -eq 1

verify.name: shortest
verify.cmd:
tmp=$(mktemp)
printf 'a b 4\na c 2\nc b 1\n' > "$tmp"
out=$(./bin/{{ npm_name }} "$tmp" a b)
echo "$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q 'distance: 3'
echo "$out" | grep -q 'path: a c b'
rm -f "$tmp"
